website_description:
Sway is an easy going beer project, scratch bakery, and kitchen. Our beer 
highlights storied ingredients sourced from the Midwest, takes inspiration 
from old world styles, and follows a minimal intervention approach using 
rustic techniques. Our beers and food are intended to be a companion to 
good company and conversation—a facilitator of connection. Sip Sway in good 
company.
